3.8.5.summary: Open soundings more reliably, read WRF point data without whole grids, and move more scientific and provider work into Rust.

highlights.title: Less scrolling in Layers
highlights.description: Keep the layer list compact while a separate area shows product, opacity, pixel rendering and the color key. Expand Details & source for the longer explanation and provenance. On narrow windows, open one layer editor at a time and return to the list with a back action.

highlights.title: A clearer point inspector
highlights.description: Scan compact readouts with aligned units and an active-panel highlight. Select a reading to switch panels, copy the point’s coordinates, and keep Open sounding within reach while viewing source details.

highlights.title: A current weather briefing on Overview
highlights.description: See current SPC categorical, tornado, wind and hail summaries in a compact card with a simpler heading. The card shows the published outlook day, official UTC issue and valid times, and guidance for your selected location. The briefing follows the current clock even when your forecast is archived. Compact shortcuts keep your forecast, live layers and soundings close by.

highlights.title: Observed soundings open reliably
highlights.description: Keep usable measurements when the archive repeats or misorders levels. Automatic provider selection checks the received data before accepting it and tries the next configured source when needed.

highlights.title: Clearer workspace controls
highlights.description: Frosted panels replace solid grey cards across Overview, Settings, point details, recovery and exports. See the current version on Overview and choose appearance, units and playback speed in a consistent layout. Workspace settings show your saved setup, panel count and theme, with text-only save status and retained-work notes. Use 3× or 4× in both timelines, with your choice saved. Update availability and check timing share one concise note. Restore details and buttons stay in place while saved soundings scroll. Animation keeps compact frame shortcuts and a highlighted Create GIF action. The Severe Skew-T shows HGZ as a cyan bracket at −35 °C. The Winter DGZ bracket aligns with −40 °C.

highlights.title: Focused WRF point reads
highlights.description: Read the selected NetCDF column and adjacent wind cells before converting arrays, instead of loading whole scientific grids for one sounding. Keep the existing wind rotation and surface-to-top ordering.

highlights.title: More native scientific and provider work
highlights.description: Compute more display diagnostics in Rust with the same SHARPpy conventions. Rust also handles point-provider orchestration, HRRR analysis Zarr chunks and compatibility downloads, while keeping the current CLI, provider credentials and result formats.

highlights.title: Safer opening and editing
highlights.description: Failed model, ERA5 and WRF opens remove their temporary outputs. Portable file validation and pair publication share a native owner. Editing several levels copies each changed column once and validates storm-motion edits before changing the profile.

highlights.title: Try another source for HRRR analyses
highlights.description: When the HRRR analysis archive is missing or unreadable, the app tries the standard GRIB source. Canceling a request stops it before trying another source.

3.8.4.summary: Recover your sounding session, load forecast data with less repeated work, and export each panel's complete weather overlays.

highlights.title: Restore your sounding session
highlights.description: Reopen saved profiles with completed edits, undo/redo history, selected times and the Severe or Winter view. Recovery copies stay on this device, separately from the weather cache. Recovery controls work in Windows builds and show when a copy has finished saving.

highlights.title: More reliable sounding files and edits
highlights.description: Imports display the correct filename across platforms, invalid edits report clear errors, and damaged cached images redraw automatically. Windows upgrades clean up obsolete files from the previous installation and keep saved soundings, preferences and recovery sessions. New install folders skip this cleanup.

highlights.title: Faster forecast export setup
highlights.description: Keep your resolution, frame duration and panel/layout choice between sessions. Compact icons and labels keep all hour shortcuts in one row. Select the next 6 or 12 hours, keep hours three hours apart, or Shift-click a range.

highlights.title: Independent reports and complete export overlays
highlights.description: Each map keeps its own storm-report hazard and event window. PNG, GIF and WebP exports load enabled storm reports, SPC outlooks and isobars for every selected panel and hour, then wait for those layers to finish drawing.

highlights.title: Less repeated forecast loading
highlights.description: Share decoded GRIB ingredients between parameters and panels while the source revision matches, and decode completed fields while other ranges download. Bounded batches control temporary memory. Canceling one panel keeps shared work available to another, and decode failures retain their original error.

highlights.title: Smarter sounding transfers
highlights.description: Measured transfer history and provider queues guide cloud-range or geographic-subset downloads, mirror choices and worker counts within existing request limits. Required surface or terrain companions load alongside pressure data and briefly reuse data within a model run, with separate files for each sounding.

3.8.3.summary: Play sounding forecasts through time and export complete map layouts with lossless animated WebP.

highlights.title: Animate Severe and Winter soundings
highlights.description: Choose 2–12 forecast hours or file profiles, preload the complete selection, then play or scrub the soundings on fixed plot axes. Save the animation as GIF or lossless WebP.

highlights.title: Export the whole map layout
highlights.description: Save two or four map panels together as a PNG, GIF or animated WebP. Each panel keeps its parameter, color scale, valid time and displayed overlays.

highlights.title: Lossless animated WebP
highlights.description: Preserve full-color frames with the shared Rust WebP encoder. Every selected hour loads and renders before encoding begins, and each animation loops without blended transitions.

highlights.title: Fixed lapse-rate placement
highlights.description: The Severe sounding's lapse-rate bracket and value stay at −30 °C, keeping the SFC column at −20 °C clear even when omega bars overlap the area.

3.8.2.summary: Save sharper forecast animations and lossless PNGs, see the location on sounding maps, and keep exports and cache cleanup reliable.

highlights.title: Save or copy forecast PNGs
highlights.description: Create a lossless PNG of the current forecast hour at up to UHD resolution, with the map, parameter scale, times and displayed layers. Save the file or copy the image.

highlights.title: Clearer forecast animations
highlights.description: Choose HD through UHD GIFs. Every selected hour loads and is captured before encoding, with one color palette drawn from the whole animation. Copy GIFs up to 16 MiB in the Windows app, or save them; animation after pasting depends on the receiving app.

highlights.title: Your map inside the sounding
highlights.description: Sounding images can include a locator zoomed to 6.4 times the visible Model Viewer scale. The location name appears in the sounding header above the map. A fresh capture keeps the weather layers, marker and color scale clear when you view, save or copy the sounding.

highlights.title: Clearer sounding annotations
highlights.description: Hodograph wind labels leave the rings and traces visible. The Skew-T inflow and lapse-rate annotations keep their positions when omega bars cross them. Winter diagnostics use consistent labels and units, with DGZ notes fitted inside their own column.

highlights.title: Safer Ensemble CSV exports
highlights.description: Ensemble CSVs keep their columns and member statuses. A failed export preserves the previous file, and replacing a private CSV keeps its permissions on Linux and macOS. The unused sounding Compare and Trends code has been retired.

highlights.title: More reliable exports and cache
highlights.description: Keep fractional color scales readable and map/weather layers aligned when the view moves or resizes. Failed hours, map captures and GIF encoders release the export controls. Copying an older sounding no longer blocks a replacement image or overwrites its copy status. Malformed optional cache metadata no longer blocks Storage. Invalid cache timestamps preserve pins, and cleanup checks active use again before removal.

3.8.1.summary: Restore Winter sounding images in the Windows app and extend hodograph speed rings.

highlights.title: Winter sounding repair
highlights.description: Winter images now render in the installed Windows app, including HD and UHD exports. This fixes the missing QtSvg module error.

highlights.title: Hodograph rings to 200 kt
highlights.description: Severe and Winter hodographs include speed rings through 200 kt. Your zoom and centering controls continue to work as before.

highlights.title: Clearer Winter labels
highlights.description: Read Precipitation Source and Height AGL above the source values. Severe Weather Possible Hazard Type identifies the separate hazard readout.

3.8.0.summary: Explore winter soundings, export forecast GIFs, and render sounding images from your own tools.

highlights.title: Winter soundings
highlights.description: Choose Severe or Winter above Profile. Winter keeps the large Skew-T and hodograph, wind plots and omega meter. It replaces parcel diagnostics with precipitation type and source, snow growth, icing, fog and drizzle checks, and four profiles for the lowest 3 km. The centered source readout sits above a separate possible hazard box that distinguishes snow from a blizzard signal.

highlights.title: Forecast GIF export
highlights.description: Use Export beside Smooth/Fast to choose forecast hours, resolution and speed. Every selected hour loads before lossless frame capture and GIF encoding. Preview a looping GIF with smooth map pixels, the full plot, the color scale and the forecast times. The scale also stays visible while the map loads another hour.

highlights.title: Sounding images for other apps
highlights.description: Render Severe and Winter PNGs from the command line, with optional JSON containing the saved location and image size. The locator map is hidden unless you request an overlay.

highlights.title: More reliable session cleanup
highlights.description: Closing the desktop app waits for its workers and retries temporary files that are still locked. After a process crash, a later launch recovers abandoned session files while preserving active sessions, saved exports and preferences.

3.7.2.summary: Explore RAP and RDPS maps with clearer color scales and matching radar pickers.

highlights.title: RAP and Canadian RDPS maps
highlights.description: Choose implemented RAP and RDPS map parameters with the same color tables and controls as HRRR. Choices follow the selected run’s published fields. RAP’s coverage outline follows its curved grid. RDPS keeps its native CAPE and hourly winter precipitation labels.

highlights.title: Clearer map color scales
highlights.description: Read five whole numbers beside outlined color scales near each map’s right edge. In two- and four-panel Model Viewer layouts, each panel’s eye button sits beside its title at the same height.

highlights.title: Wind, shear, and EHI color tables
highlights.description: Read 850 mb wind on a 20–80 kt scale and 0–6 km bulk shear on a 20–140 kt scale. Both Energy Helicity Index maps use the supplied color bands, with the final shade starting at 16.

highlights.title: Matching radar pickers
highlights.description: Choose radar networks, sites, products and tilts in movable popups that match the forecast and radar-time pickers. Search sites by code or place name and see the current selection.

highlights.title: Simpler status and map recovery
highlights.description: The backend status popup shows service details directly. Status and storage usage remain available if the calculation engine is missing. If the map cannot start, its message, retry button and station list are centered in the available map area, with room for point details when open.

3.7.1.summary: Live radar automatically follows the latest available scan.

highlights.title: Automatic radar scan time
highlights.description: Live Tracking loads the latest available scan for the selected radar and keeps it updated. Changing sites returns to Live. Radar time shows the actual scan time and age, including delayed scans.

highlights.title: More reliable radar sources
highlights.description: Australian, German, MRRL and European OPERA radar can show recent delayed scans with their actual times. Compatible OPERA scans use the provider's current download service and supported license information.

3.7.0.summary: Explore more radar networks and choose how your sounding images look.

highlights.title: German radar sites
highlights.description: View precipitation-scan reflectivity from 17 DWD radar sites, with source attribution and measured values where available. The scan elevation varies by direction.

highlights.title: European OPERA radar
highlights.description: Discover European radar sites and view compatible lowest-elevation reflectivity scans, including high-precision 16-bit and floating-point sweeps, with their source credits. Availability depends on each station's data format and license.

highlights.title: French radar via MRRL
highlights.description: View reflectivity from additional Météo-France sites in France and overseas through MRRL InterRAD. See the displayed radar's source credit at the bottom left of Live Tracking.

highlights.title: Choose a radar network
highlights.description: Filter the site picker by network and move to a nearby radar in the selected network. Product and elevation controls follow each source's available capabilities.

highlights.title: Radar station codes
highlights.description: Search by radar code or place and click a map label to select a site. Borders show selected and unavailable sites. Choose a UTC time or step by five minutes; see the actual scan time as radar data loads.

highlights.title: Sounding display colors
highlights.description: Choose Dark, Light or Protanopia for sounding images in Settings → Appearance. Your choice is saved and applies to edited and exported soundings.

3.6.0.summary: Native box soundings, a more compact workspace and clearer controls and recovery throughout the app.

highlights.title: Native box soundings
highlights.description: Draw a region in Model Viewer to open an area-weighted sounding from supported native GRIB grids. See up to 64 individual grid traces behind the mean in the Skew-T and hodograph, retain them in saved files, and calculate diagnostics from all contributing valid columns.

highlights.title: More room for weather
highlights.description: Use text, controls, panels and popups at 90% of their previous size. Moving highlights, press feedback and shorter popup exits respect reduced motion. What’s new softens the whole workspace behind it.

highlights.title: Choose sounding runs by date
highlights.description: Pick a Model sounding run with the custom UTC calendar and separate cycle selector. Keep latitude and longitude as entered, with hemisphere labels that follow their signs and forecast choices that respect the selected cycle.

highlights.title: Clear recovery where it matters
highlights.description: Read compact notices beside the failed operation, use its relevant retry or recovery action, and expand Details for diagnostics. Redraw oversized boxes, reload incompatible parameter lists and recover map layers without losing your selection.

highlights.title: Forecast maps and sounding controls
highlights.description: See simulated Composite Reflectivity on GFS and use familiar parameter groups on native GDPS maps. Map details use two columns, visibility controls show loading, and sounding controls use a consistent layout.

highlights.title: Reliable edits and missing values
highlights.description: Recalculate profile edits faster. Cancel interrupted box draws and corner resizes without losing the committed region. Keep unavailable effective-layer winds masked and handle saturated surfaces consistently with point soundings.

3.5.5.summary: Earlier preparation of large forecast soundings, faster repeat requests and an updated profile guide.

highlights.title: Faster repeat forecast soundings
highlights.description: The native decoder can reuse the previously decoded column at the same point when the GRIB file has not changed.

highlights.title: Prepare large forecast soundings sooner
highlights.description: Process large forecast files while they download so sounding preparation can finish sooner. The complete download and required surface data are still checked before opening the profile.

highlights.title: Consistent MCS maintenance probability
highlights.description: Use the analyzed sounding's validated MCS maintenance probability so repeated analyses agree with the MCS index.

highlights.title: Sounding reading guide
highlights.description: The sounding parameter guide now explains how to read parcel ascent, instability, and winds together.

3.5.4.summary: Labelled isobars, complete forecast overlays and native weather fetching.

highlights.title: Labelled isobars
highlights.description: Add smooth mean sea-level pressure lines over any model field, with numeric labels every 4 hPa. Follow the selected model, run and hour on supported HRRR, GFS and ECMWF forecasts, and save the layer separately in each panel.

highlights.title: Complete forecast overlays
highlights.description: Keep height contours and wind barbs available on dense forecast maps. Display detail adjusts within the existing size limit while retaining the requested contour interval and missing-data gaps.

highlights.title: Native weather fetching
highlights.description: Fetch model-field records with native parallel downloading, retries and cancellation. Stop remaining requests when a batch fails, and reuse completed contours when returning to the same forecast.

3.5.3.summary: Working ECMWF 9 km soundings, clearer STP charts and faster native calculations.

highlights.title: ECMWF 9 km soundings restored
highlights.description: Open forecast soundings using the correct pressure-level download and its surface data, including locations that previously failed with a missing pressure-coordinate error.

highlights.title: Readable STP charts
highlights.description: Keep the Effective Layer STP title and probability text compact, with enough room for each line on Windows and Linux.

highlights.title: Faster native calculations
highlights.description: Reuse repeated parcel calculations and verified grid lookups while reading weather values from the current file. Initial weather-data downloads and decoding still depend on the provider and file size.

3.5.2.summary: A map ready at startup, current forecast models, more accurate parcel diagnostics and protected profile edits.

highlights.title: Ready forecast workspace
highlights.description: Load the map behind Overview as the app opens and keep it ready across workspaces. Retire NAM and its nests, SREF, HREF and the offered HiResW variants from model choices; RRFS and REFS remain available.

highlights.title: Correct parcel diagnostics
highlights.description: Preserve saturated-surface LCL and LFC values, average temperature and moisture independently when readings are missing, and retain usable CAPE layers beneath an incomplete profile top.

highlights.title: Protected sounding edits
highlights.description: Switch between soundings while a recalculation finishes without enabling competing edits or losing newer chart selections and profile work.

highlights.title: Accurate weather requests
highlights.description: Validate model download ranges, keep an available provider when mirror checks fail, and include later observation pages when finding the nearest station report. Refresh forecast-model access, NetCDF reading and HTTPS trust data.

highlights.title: Consistent live history
highlights.description: Use actual Level II cut times when matching radar history, including cached cuts, and avoid repeatedly requesting alert snapshots already known to be unavailable.

highlights.title: Cleaner app updates
highlights.description: Finish backend shutdown and clear the session cache before Windows launches the update installer, without stalling the app. Existing installations can detect these fixes as a new application version.

3.5.1.summary: Storm reports in Live Tracking, clearer overlay recovery and faster first sounding display.

highlights.title: Storm reports in Live Tracking
highlights.description: Show tornado, hail and wind reports alongside radar and alerts. Choose an event window and hazard filter, inspect event details on hover, and include reports when caching or replaying the past hour. Reports follow the selected live time and remain available in Model Viewer.

highlights.title: Correct supplemental radar times
highlights.description: Supplemental US radar products use their published observation times, avoiding false future-scan failures. Missing scans show an availability warning with useful recovery.

highlights.title: Clear alert-history recovery
highlights.description: Uncached past NWS alerts show a history warning with Return to Live. Reopening controls or looping playback does not keep requesting missing alert snapshots, and copied diagnostics explain the availability limit. Connection and decoding failures keep their retry actions.

highlights.title: Faster sounding startup
highlights.description: In local UHD measurements, the first-render median fell from 5.15 s to 3.37 s, with about 160 MiB less initial peak memory use. Repeated-render timings were essentially unchanged.

3.5.0.summary: Australian radar, 2–5 km updraft tracks and clearer sounding controls.

highlights.title: Australian radar
highlights.description: Find 67 Australian sites in Live Tracking and view Base Reflectivity or Doppler Velocity from MRRL at the lowest available elevation. Scan times, missing coverage and range folding stay distinct.

highlights.title: Updraft tracks
highlights.description: View 1-hour and 3-hour maximum updraft helicity for the 2–5 km AGL layer on HRRR and supporting models. Both use the shared 0–400 m²/s² colour table. The 3-hour field starts at F003 and requires the complete interval.

highlights.title: Clearer map details
highlights.description: Toggle OpenStreetMap roads and road names for each panel. Storm-report legends use full hazard names, and surface stations share consistent styling with a subtle stale-report marker.

highlights.title: Compact sounding choices
highlights.description: Choose models, runs, forecast hours and launch times in small glass popups. Search models, select UTC hour tiles and read helper text and profile details clearly over bright maps.

highlights.title: Simpler profile editing
highlights.description: Choose one pressure level, switch between temperature, dewpoint and wind, then step through adjacent levels. Height charts and diagnostics use compact dropdowns. Inspect, parcel, view and export controls stay together.

highlights.title: Native performance improvements
highlights.description: Includes the v3.4.2 Rust migration baseline for downloads, live weather, map processing and sounding calculations. Workspaces load when first opened, while the map stays ready after its first visit.

3.4.2.summary: The Rust migration baseline included in v3.5.0 speeds up weather downloads, map processing and sounding preparation.

highlights.title: Native weather fetching
highlights.description: Rust handles warnings, watches, storm reports, surface observations, IEM sounding downloads and GOES transfers through reused HTTP clients. Source times, missing data, cancellation and provider errors remain visible.

highlights.title: Resumable model downloads
highlights.description: Rust coordinates forecast source selection, bounded parallel range downloads, retries, saved fragments and atomic assembly. Transfers validate the source object before reusing fragments and preserve progress and cancellation.

highlights.title: Faster map preparation
highlights.description: Rust processes radar samples, contours, wind barbs and terrain-relative map fields while preserving coordinates, units and missing-data gaps.

highlights.title: Shared sounding calculations
highlights.description: Wind interpolation, convective temperatures, parcel levels, Storm Slinky and analogue searches reuse native calculations. Ensemble downloads run with bounded concurrency and preserve member order and individual failures.

highlights.title: Provider compatibility
highlights.description: IGRA decoding, ECMWF inventories and locator borders use Rust behind the existing interfaces. Scientific equivalence and source-only compatibility remain covered by the release checks.

3.4.1.summary: SPC outlooks follow the selected forecast time, clear outdated risk areas and refresh every five minutes.

highlights.title: Current outlooks for the selected time
highlights.description: Changing the selected hour loads its own outlook issuance. Current Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3 forecasts are checked by their valid windows, including morning issuances before 12Z.

highlights.title: Respect outlooks with no plotted risk areas
highlights.description: Valid outlooks with no plotted risk areas clear older polygons instead of bringing back an earlier forecast.

highlights.title: Five-minute refresh and recovery
highlights.description: Enabled SPC layers refresh every five minutes in Model Viewer. Missing recent products are retried within five minutes, so a temporary gap does not hide an outlook for six hours.

3.1.0.summary: Live weather joins forecasts and soundings in one workspace.

highlights.title: Live Tracking
highlights.description: Follow radar, satellite imagery, surface observations, warnings and watches. Replay the past hour where the source provides history.

highlights.title: More radar detail
highlights.description: Explore high-resolution Base Reflectivity, Velocity, Correlation Coefficient and Enhanced Echo Tops, with verified tilts and values on hover.

highlights.title: Your panels, your setup
highlights.description: Use up to four synchronized panels. Layers, map projection, playback and display preferences are remembered on this device.

highlights.title: Clearer downloads and storage
highlights.description: Load forecast hours before playback and manage forecast and live-weather caches separately in Settings.

highlights.title: Safer sounding edits
highlights.description: Closing a sounding with local changes asks before discarding your edits and undo history.

3.2.0.summary: A faster workspace with clearer downloads and more reliable caching.

highlights.title: Faster maps and soundings
highlights.description: Upcoming forecast images are prepared before playback advances. Repeated sounding requests reuse downloaded model data and prepared rendering work.

highlights.title: More control over downloads
highlights.description: See which forecast hours are saved and which are ready to play. Check the cache, retry missing hours, or stop a model-sounding download. Stopped downloads no longer block new requests.

highlights.title: More reliable caching
highlights.description: Forecast caches have size and age limits. Active downloads stay protected, and failed sounding downloads clean up their temporary files.

highlights.title: A simpler Overview
highlights.description: Start with Model Viewer, Live Tracking or Soundings. Model availability and recent activity stay close at hand in expandable rows.

highlights.title: Release highlights in the app
highlights.description: See a short What’s new popup after a version change, and revisit the highlights anytime in Settings → Updates.

3.2.1.summary: More reliable maps and soundings, with clearer recovery and safer saved settings.

highlights.title: More reliable forecast changes
highlights.description: Forecast changes recover while older requests stop. Shared downloads keep running for panels that need them; leaving Model Viewer pauses automatic preloading. Failed downloads stop their remaining transfers, and provider failures report their original cause.

highlights.title: Release unused rendering memory
highlights.description: Switching between globe and flat maps releases unused graphics resources. Completed and failed sounding renders release unused image buffers before the next request. Scientific values, profile edits and lossless HD and UHD exports keep their existing quality.

highlights.title: Every sounding time
highlights.description: Choose any time in an imported forecast file. Each time keeps its own edits and undo history, and exported charts use the selected profile. Typed station IDs survive source-tab changes.

highlights.title: Clearer Map Controls And Recovery
highlights.description: Controls use orange hover feedback throughout both themes. Maps remove the heavy road network for clearer weather and labels. Manage forecast downloads in one panel with animated hour lists; the Fast/Smooth icon sits beside Loop. Drawn maps stay available through recoverable rendering errors. Retry failed maps, imagery and overlays. Pan with arrow keys and press Enter to inspect the map’s centre.

highlights.title: Settings stay usable
highlights.description: If device storage is unavailable or full, workspace settings keep working for the current session. Long release highlights scroll with their close controls in reach. Unchanged map labels reuse their layout during forecast playback.

highlights.title: Updated bundled security components
highlights.description: The Windows app includes a maintained Python and TLS runtime, updated libraries for network access and weather files, and signed installer checks. Downloads include checksums and a detailed component inventory.

3.4.0.summary: More global and regional forecast maps, clearer sounding controls and safer app updates.

highlights.title: More forecast choices
highlights.description: Browse CONUS, Global and Regional models with more supported GFS, ECMWF, NAM and HRW fields. Open ECMWF 9km and GDPS soundings, or explore AIGFS maps. Unavailable parameters stay hidden; AIGFS is maps only.

highlights.title: Copy a useful diagnostic
highlights.description: Copy a failed operation's provider, time, error category and recovery action from Logs. Credentials, raw errors and request details stay out.

highlights.title: Understand graphics quality
highlights.description: Compare Automatic, Low, Balanced and High in one view. See the active profile and when Automatic reduces rendering quality.

highlights.title: Clearer sounding readouts
highlights.description: Read glass tooltips in both themes, edit levels in a compact sidebar and export annotations in your chosen units. Failed recalculations keep your chart and pending edit.

highlights.title: Clearer controls
highlights.description: Find parameters with readable search and separate descriptions. Navigate without hover readouts, retry from clear popups and browse hours while downloads continue. Saved maps reopen offline.

highlights.title: Review work before updating
highlights.description: Review work before installing. Preferences and disk caches stay; open soundings, edits and history are lost. New or unfinished edits trigger another review, and failed preference saves stop installation. Exported PNGs cannot restore editable work.

3.3.0.summary: Clearer forecast and radar playback, larger sounding views, and simpler map controls.

highlights.title: Forecast hours and radar scans
highlights.description: Forecast hours show green outlines for cached images, blue for downloads and red for failures, with direct retries. Radar scans has a matching movable picker before Site Tilt, distinguishing available, loading, missing, delayed and failed frames while keeping playback compact.

highlights.title: Simpler map controls
highlights.description: Manage layer order, visibility and legends in a centered, movable glass popup. Opacity and provider options appear inside each layer’s settings. Search stations or radar sites in a larger popup; radar-site selection is available only in Live Tracking. Lighter hover cards and centered recovery notices keep the map readable.

highlights.title: Keep your place
highlights.description: Keep the exact map position, zoom, selected point and inspector state when changing models, parameters, panel layouts or workspaces, including changes made immediately after moving the map.

highlights.title: More room for sounding inspection
highlights.description: Swap the sidebar between sources and controls to give the chart more room. Inspect linked Skew-T and hodograph levels with separate transparent readouts, including levels above the visible hodograph trace. Compare original and edited values, identify edited levels and jump through undo history. Display all four height charts together.

highlights.title: Clear requests and exports
highlights.description: Check coordinate ranges and model coverage before requesting a sounding. Follow download, decoding, calculation and rendering stages, and cancel with your inputs and open profiles retained. HD/UHD exports show PNG size, dimensions and a reliable ready state; unchanged images reuse completed renders.

highlights.title: Updates and maintenance
highlights.description: Automatic update checks run once per UTC window starting at 00:00 and 12:00, remembered across restarts. Missed checks catch up when the app is open and online; manual checks remain available anytime. Weather-file, image, certificate, native and build dependencies are updated. The README has a simple download-history graph built from measured application-package counts.
